subject: Live chat sessions timing out intermittently — exec attention requested
messages:
From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@asterialabs.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Nguyen <jane.nguyen@asterialabs.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Live chat sessions timing out intermittently

Kim,

We started seeing a spike in 5xx/429s this morning across our customer-facing chat widgets. Symptoms:
- Sessions drop after ~45–60s of silence (no user typing) with a 504/stream timeout returned to client.
- Clients then aggressively retry, which briefly drives 429s for the same user population.
- Impact: about 18% of requests failing for a subset of users in us-west-2 between 08:00–11:30 PT.

Attached: session_dump_20270822.log and network_trace_asteria_22.pcap. We capture client logs showing the retry loop. This is hurting an active campaign — asking for immediate help and, if needed, exec attention.

Best,
Derek
Head of Product Ops
Asteria Labs
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@asterialabs.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live chat sessions timing out intermittently

Derek — thanks for the quick report and the captures. We see the same error spike on our end for your account.
Immediate notes:
- Preliminary traces show idle-connection pruning hitting some long-poll websocket sessions around ~50s of inactivity on a subset of edge proxies.
- There is also evidence of a short-lived fallback behavior in the client that reopens the connection without backoff which creates a transient 429 surge.

Monica & Markus, can you pull server-side stream health metrics (idle-evictions, proxy keepalive expirations, and per-pool 429/5xx counters) for asteria-prod-usw2 and surface any recent config changes?

Derek — we'll prioritize this and loop back with an interim mitigation within the hour. If we need to involve leadership or credits, we will escalate.

—Kim
Director, Account Escalations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@asterialabs.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live chat sessions timing out intermittently

On it. Initial pulls (08:00–11:30 PT window):
- Edge proxy (usw2-edge-4/5) show elevated idle-connection cleanup events where keepalive timers are firing ~48–55s. Normal is 120s.
- Upstream route that serves Asteria is routing to a BGP-pooled set that had a config rollback yesterday for a perf experiment (rollback id: route-roll-20270821).
- 429 counters correlate with the sudden return of connection resets from proxies; clients retry immediately and hit quota checks on the serving pool.

Plan:
1) Revert the keepalive/idle timer to 120s on the two affected edge nodes (hotfix) — 10–15 min to roll.
2) Temporarily increase per-tenant soft quota for asteria-prod-usw2 to absorb retry bursts.
3) Work with Client SDK team to investigate a conservative retry backoff by EOD.

I will start the hotfix and update here.

—Monica
SRE
Redwood Inference

- We identified two edge nodes with an unintended keepalive regression due to a config rollback; we've queued an immediate hotfix to restore keepalive timers to 120s. Expected impact: drop in idle disconnects and fewer client-triggered retries.
- We'll also temporarily raise your tenant soft quota (no billing impact) to avoid quota-based 429s while the client retries subside.

Please watch your dashboards over the next 30 min and let us know any change. We're treating this as high priority.

—Kim

Thanks — I can already see the failed session rate dropping. Two quick asks while you continue:
1) Can the team share a short RCA draft for our execs? We need language about root cause, impact window, and mitigation steps.
2) Will Redwood push a temporary SDK client change to add exponential backoff by default? Our mobile app currently retries immediately and is a big contributor to the spike.

Jane (our CTO) is on the thread; if we need formal executive sync please ping her.

Derek
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@asterialabs.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jane Nguyen <jane.nguyen@asterialabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Live chat sessions timing out intermittently — exec attention requested

Derek / Jane — follow-up and draft RCA: 
Summary (impact): Between 2027-08-22 08:00 PT and 2027-08-22 11:30 PT, Asteria Labs experienced elevated chat session failures (peak ~18% of session attempts) manifesting as stream timeouts (504) and quota 429s. Root cause, timeline, and action items below.

Root cause: A config rollback (route-roll-20270821) unintentionally reduced keepalive/idle timers on two us-west-2 edge proxies from 120s to ~50s. The shortened timer caused idle client sessions to be pruned. Several client SDKs (notably Asteria's mobile) immediately retried connections without backoff, which led to transient quota saturation and 429s on the serving pools.

Timeline:
- 08:00 PT: Incident begins; elevated keepalive evictions observed.
- 08:18 PT: Error rate climbs; internal alerting triggers.
- 08:35 PT: Asteria reports via support; diagnostic captures received.
- 16:36 PT: Initial account lead confirms correlation (this thread).
- 16:58 PT: Hotfix queued and rolled on affected edge nodes (keepalive restored to 120s).
- 17:05 PT: Temporary soft quota increase applied for asteria-prod-usw2.
- 17:30 PT: Error rate returned to baseline; monitoring set to watch for regressions.

Mitigations implemented:
- Hotfix: restored keepalive to 120s on affected edges.
- Throttle relief: temporary tenant soft quota increase to absorb retries (no billing).
- Client guidance: asked Asteria to adopt exponential backoff in their next mobile patch; Redwood will also ship an SDK update to include conservative retry default within 48 hours.

Follow-ups:
- Postmortem will be published in JIRA-INF-4721 with detailed logs and change review.
- SRE to add a regression guard preventing keepalive < 90s on public edge pools.
- Product to coordinate SDK backoff default and communicate with customers about recommended retry patterns.

Attached: session_dump_20270822.log, network_trace_asteria_22.pcap

If you'd like a 15–20 minute exec sync to close the loop, Evelyn and I are available this week.

—Kim
Director, Account Escalations
Redwood Inference
